decisions.reason: As a 2023 extension of the laser range it still fits the portfolio, but its lower website prominence and more manual workstation character make it somewhat more vulnerable than the more strongly promoted printer and system products.
This thermal inkjet printer is close to the firm’s core offer, stayed on its own product page through 2024, and supports the firm’s strategy of broad application-specific coding solutions.
The piezo inkjet printer remains a core adjacent marking technology with continued dedicated web presence, so a large expanding firm with in-house R&D would normally keep it in market.
The industrial laser marking systems were newly launched in 2024 and featured on the home page, indicating strategic importance and a very low likelihood of withdrawal so soon after launch.
The compact laser marking cabin was explicitly promoted as new in 2024 and strengthens the laser portfolio, so management would usually continue backing it unless demand clearly disappoints.

Although this lubricant printing system is more specialized and only mentioned on the website, its trade-fair award and relevance for industrial traceability in sheet metal support keeping it on the market.
